units.source_text: 阿光接过来的铁线圈，火苗已经燃烧到这圆圈的末端了。

en.t: By the time A Guang took the iron hoop, the flame had already burned to the end of the ring.

units.source_text: 与跳绳一样，她把圆圈从后面转到前面，又转到脸部，

en.t: As if skipping rope, she swung the hoop from behind her to the front, then up toward her face,

units.source_text: 耳旁响起火焰的扑扑声，火光刺眼，难道今天的火焰要钻进心窝里来吗？

en.t: the flames crackling beside her ears and the firelight stinging her eyes; was today's flame going to burrow into the depths of her heart?

units.source_text: 她双手顿时完全失灵，失去了平衡。

en.t: All at once her hands failed her completely, and she lost her balance.
She had no choice but to try again.

units.source_text: 脚下刚越过铁丝圈，她觉得这回只有马儿腾空而起，

en.t: Just as her feet passed over the iron hoop, she felt that this time only the horse had leaped into the air,

units.source_text: 好像失去了自己的立足之地，眼睛也花起来了。

en.t: as though she had lost the ground beneath her, and her eyes began to blur as well.
